review_description: Dan from Tactical Power came to help us with our system after another company had installed our system poorly. Dan did a fabulous job of fault finding reinstalling and upgrading our system. He was always clear about the work he was doing and was extremely helpful in making sure we fully understood our system and how to use it. Dan even emailed step by step instructions for us to refer to. Dan has always been very responsive to calls or emails and has always given excellent customer services.I would not hesitate in recommending Dan from Tactical power.
